reason: My NRO balance is small, under 5 lakh, and my relative in India can sort out the bank side for free. Paying $79 or more to move a few lakh feels like a lot when I already have people for this.
objection: A relative can do this for free, and on a small balance a flat fee eats a noticeable percent. I also don't know if I can trust a new company with my money and my tax paperwork.
would_change_my_mind: My accountant telling me they have used it and it saved me real hassle, or a much larger balance after a property sale or inheritance where a mistake would cost far more than the fee.
